AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.CompactProgressiveCoefficients.continuous_coefficient_along_compact_process.{u_1,
    u_2}
  {Ω : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace S] [CompactSpace S]
  [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace S] [SecondCountableTopology S] [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S]
  {filtration : MeasureTheory.Filtration NNReal inferInstance} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (X : NNReal → Ω → S) (hX : Measurable (Function.uncurry X))
  (hProgressive : MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive filtration X) (c : NNReal × S → ℝ) (hc : Continuous c)
  (T : NNReal) (p : ENNReal) :
  have b := fun t ω => c (t, X t ω);
  MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive filtration b ∧
    (∀ (ω : Ω), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => b t ω) (TimeMeasure.upTo T)) ∧
      MeasureTheory.MemLp (ProgressiveL2.processFunction b) p (ElementaryItoIntegral.processTimeMeasure μ T)

def MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : {Ω : Type u_1} →
  {ι : Type u_2} →
    {m : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} Ω} →
      [inst : Preorder.{u_2} ι] →
        {β : Type u_3} →
          [TopologicalSpace.{u_3} β] →
            [MeasurableSpace.{u_2} ι] → @MeasureTheory.Filtration.{u_1, u_2} Ω ι inst m → (ι → Ω → β) → Prop :=
fun {Ω} {ι} {m} [inst : Preorder.{u_2} ι] {β} [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace.{u_3} β] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace.{u_2} ι] f
    u =>
  ∀ (i : ι),
    @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable.{max u_2 u_1, u_3}
      (Prod.{u_2, u_1}
        (@Subtype.{u_2 + 1} ι fun x =>
          @Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} ι (Set.{u_2} ι) (@Set.instMembership.{u_2} ι) (@Set.Iic.{u_2} ι inst i) x)
        Ω)
      β inst_1
      (@MeasurableSpace.prod.{u_2, u_1}
        (@Subtype.{u_2 + 1} ι fun x =>
          @Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} ι (Set.{u_2} ι) (@Set.instMembership.{u_2} ι) (@Set.Iic.{u_2} ι inst i) x)
        Ω
        (@Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.{u_2} ι
          (fun x =>
            @Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} ι (Set.{u_2} ι) (@Set.instMembership.{u_2} ι) (@Set.Iic.{u_2} ι inst i) x)
          inst_2)
        (@MeasureTheory.Filtration.seq.{u_1, u_2} Ω ι inst m f i))
      fun p =>
      u
        (@Subtype.val.{u_2 + 1} ι
          (fun x =>
            @Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} ι (Set.{u_2} ι) (@Set.instMembership.{u_2} ι) (@Set.Iic.{u_2} ι inst i) x)
          (@Prod.fst.{u_2, u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_2} ι (@Set.Iic.{u_2} ι inst i)) Ω p))
        (@Prod.snd.{u_2, u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_2} ι (@Set.Iic.{u_2} ι inst i)) Ω p)

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ElementaryItoIntegral.processTimeMeasure.{u_1} : {Omega :
    Type u_1} →
  [inst : MeasurableSpace Omega] → MeasureTheory.Measure Omega → NNReal → MeasureTheory.Measure (Omega × NNReal) :=
fun {Omega} [MeasurableSpace Omega] mu T => mu.prod (TimeMeasure.upTo T)
def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.processFunction.{u_1} : {Omega : Type u_1} →
  (NNReal → Omega → ℝ) → Omega × NNReal → ℝ :=
fun {Omega} eta z => eta z.2 z.1
def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo : NNReal → MeasureTheory.Measure NNReal :=
fun T => MeasureTheory.Measure.comap NNReal.toReal (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 ↑T))
